info.name: MSL API Updates (2026-11)
info.description:
# MSL API updates — Nov 2026

Documents API work shipped from late November 2026: past-question pre-seen/background + reformat/verify issues, spoken chat SSE, TTS voices (including clone), Qdrant delete parity, and optimised admin AI usage.

## Base URL
`{{baseUrl}}` — API origin with **no trailing slash**. Local default: `http://localhost:4000`.

## Required headers (almost every route)
| Header | Variable | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{token}}` | JWT after login / device verify |
| `x-device-id` | `{{deviceId}}` | Must match user `device_id` or **403** |
| `x-timezone` | `{{timezone}}` | Optional IANA zone; activity logging |

## Collection variables
Set `token` and `deviceId` after auth. Other ids are filled by Test scripts where noted.

## SSE audio chat
Streaming chat returns `text/event-stream` with events:
- `text` — token/sentence payload (`text`, optional `finished` / `isFinal` / `limitInfo`)
- `audio` — WAV base64 (`audio`, `mimeType`, `chunkIndex`, `isFinal`)
- `error` — failure message
- `end` — stream closed

Postman shows the raw SSE body; desktop apps parse events for typewriter text + buffered playback.

request.description:
SSE stream. Same body as `/chat` plus optional `voiceId` / `voiceName`.

Behaviour:
1. Streams spoken plain-text tokens as `event: text` (for letter-by-letter UI)
2. Compiles Gemini TTS per sentence as `event: audio` (WAV base64)
3. Final `text` event may include HTML + `limitInfo`
4. Ends with `event: end`

Uses the same lifetime quota as text chat. 10 req/min.

In Postman: send the request and inspect the raw body for `event:` / `data:` lines.

body.raw:
{
  "question": "Explain how I should approach question 1 under exam conditions.",
  "scope": "paper",
  "paperId": "{{pastQuestionPaperId}}",
  "voiceId": "{{voiceId}}",
  "history": []
}
